rationale: The assistant went straight to the correct first step (isolate, clean filter, check spray arms spin and jets are clear), tracked the customer's findings accurately and reached the right fix with sensible prevention advice about scraping plates and cleaning the filter regularly. It never asked about salt, rinse aid or the programme used, so the aggravating factors in the hidden truth (quick wash, no salt) went unaddressed. The 'To check a suitable replacement' model-number panel was shown twice with no evidence any part was needed, which confused the customer, and the final message oddly opened with 'Before you start, switch it off and unplug it' when the job was already done.
